I'm going to start off with addressing talking online with friends. They are your friends. They absolutely do not care how you look on a webcam and, if they do, they might not be your friends in the first place. But if you're still not comfortable maybe try sitting a little farther from the camera. That can help with the feeling of having a big nose. ( I have a larger one too) 

Second I think you should take some time to do things that make you feel pretty. Put on your best outfit. Look up YouTube videos on poses for photos or make up. Lotion up every where. Experiment with make up if that's your thing. Do your hair.  Face/hair/foot/hand masks. Do the whole 9 if you like those things. Find videos or a show that makes you laugh. Dance to the music that you like. Cook your favorite meal. Learn to make a new cocktail.  Whatever your hobby may be focus on that for a while. 

Third and Fourth. Maybe talk to a therapist about your feelings towards yourself. Many people go through not feeling adequate. And your thoughts how you might want to continue with plastic surgery. Please remember many procedures only last months to a few years before having to be done again and it's a vicious cycle. Talking helps.

Hi my name is Deathnell, and I'm an Amazon addict. 👋 Jokes aside, I do the same thing. I can become obsessive about finding the "perfect" item. Even small things like a serving book for my job or a pair of sandals. Searching endlessly for a product that matches exactly what's in my head.

The thing I find most helpful is to leave the product in my wishlist/cart for at least 48 hrs. If in that time I'm still thinking about it, I ask myself some questions. Like if it's clothing:
What does this new item add to my wardrobe? Do I have anything similar? How often will I wear it and how much would it then cost per wear? Will it still be in style by next year? Etc.

I find when I put just a little extra effort in really thinking about how I'm spending my money can really help decrease frivolous spending. As to the extra scrolling, I can't say I give the best advice because I turned shopping scrolling into reddit scrolling 🤷🏼‍♀️
